speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The monitoring period has come to an end.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The wind park is now producing a substantial amount of renewable energy for Arcadia. However, the final reports show that not all of its impacts have been successfully addressed.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Some of the measures have helped reduce the impact on birds, but disturbances around the wind park are still being observed.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Marine ecosystems have also been affected. Some of the measures reduced the disturbance, but they could not eliminate it completely.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: The fishing communities have had to adapt to the changes caused by the wind park. Some new opportunities have emerged, but not everyone has benefited equally.

speaker: PORT AUTHORITY
text: The changes to the maritime infrastructure have protected some of our interests, but they have also created additional costs and challenges.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia has taken steps to address the project's impacts, but some of the consequences could have been reduced further.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The wind park has delivered important benefits for Arcadia's energy transition.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: But this project has also shown that achieving one goal can create challenges for others.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Some of the decisions you made protected certain interests, while creating compromises elsewhere.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: There is no perfect solution to a project of this scale. However, the consequences of each decision must be understood and carefully managed.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Arcadia will continue monitoring the wind park and addressing the problems that remain.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Your assignment is complete. Thank you for your work.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Your ship is waiting at the harbour. We wish you a safe journey home across the Conan Sea.
